title: Find Median from Data Stream
statement_short: Design a data structure that receives a stream of integers and efficiently supports adding a new number and finding the median of all elements added so far.
constraints: -10^5 <= num <= 10^5, at most 5 \* 10^4 calls will be made to addNum and findMedian
hint: Up to 5 \* 10^4 streaming calls require O(log n) insertion using two balanced heaps (max-heap for lower half, min-heap for upper half).
why_not: Right: Heap / Priority Queue uses two balanced heaps (max-heap for left half, min-heap for right half) to support O(log n) addNum and O(1) findMedian. Not Two Pointers: Two pointers require an array insertion which takes O(n) shift time per stream addition. Not Binary Search: Binary search finds target insertion index in O(log n), but array shifting still takes O(n) time. Not Sorting: Re-sorting array on every stream addition costs O(n log n) time per insertion.
complexity: O(log n) add, O(1) median time, O(n) space
